purpose: Avoid unnecessary large ordinary-holder balances while preserving exact token allocations and transparent custody.

ordinaryHolderTarget.rule: Target only. Exact approved allocations, public recipients and existing on-chain balances are not silently rewritten. Exceptions require explicit disclosure.

WLDZ.legacy: Keep 5M in treasury until claim-distributor fanout to verified legacy recipients.
WLDZ.devCity: Keep 5M in treasury until verified roster fanout; target 100k per recipient under current WLDZ plan unless superseded.
WLDZ.founding100: Keep 10M in treasury; release 100k per verified launch rather than parking 10M in one ordinary wallet.
WLDZ.team: Use vesting/claim schedules. Do not park the whole team reserve in one ordinary personal wallet.
WLDZ.impact: Ring-fence under treasury accounting; do not create a 10M ordinary-holder balance merely for custody.
WLDZ.stagedLiquidity: Remain treasury/liquidity reserve until reviewed LP deployment.

RVIV.devClaims: 30M across the approved seven-dev claim set; no single dev receives the entire bucket.
RVIV.legacyClaims: 20M across the approved legacy claimant set.
RVIV.devCity: 20M intended for 100 verified DevCity recipients, 200k each when roster is approved.
RVIV.team: 30M reserved for approved vesting beneficiaries rather than one ordinary personal wallet.
RVIV.impact: 20M remains treasury-reserved until a concentration-aware impact custody/fanout route is approved.
RVIV.liquidity: 30M existing initial liquidity plus 40M staged reserve are liquidity custody, not ordinary holder allocations.

PNEX.chance: Immediate and vested Chance allocations fan out to verified recipients; no single recipient receives the whole pool.
PNEX.developerVesting: 25M uses multiple verified developer beneficiaries with 90-day cliff and 24 monthly releases.
PNEX.flywheel: 47.5M governed program reserve, not an ordinary personal holder.

MRCL.miracleTeam: 69.6M is governed 4-of-8 team-vault custody with individual vesting ledgers; it is not a single-person holding.
MRCL.miracleMagic: 69.6M is mission/gift supply custody with verified beneficiary releases.
MRCL.remaining: 187.92M stays unallocated/custodied until an explicit allocation decision; do not scatter it merely to make holder charts look distributed.

ownerControlledAllocationWallets.use: Operational separation of personally controlled allocations only.
ownerControlledAllocationWallets.disclosure: Every such wallet must remain marked OWNER_CONTROLLED / COMMON_BENEFICIAL_CONTROL in Worldz records.
ownerControlledAllocationWallets.signerRule: Extra wallets controlled by one person do not count as additional independent multisig people.
